## Checklist

- [ ] Every new statement of fact points at a source in `data/sources/` with a locator (page, section or row) and, for claims, an exact quote.
- [ ] Sources are public. Nothing here came from a private account, a login, active scanning, or contact with a subject.
- [ ] Legal posture is exact: convicted / sanctioned / charged / officially attributed / affected-organization report / research attributed. A charge is described as an allegation.
- [ ] No merge of records on the strength of a shared name, handle, photo or IP alone. `identity_boundary` says what the record is and is not.
- [ ] No excluded data: phone numbers, street addresses, identity-document images, payment-card or bank details, victim details, present whereabouts, biometric inference.
- [ ] `make validate` passes and `make build` output is committed.
